pages.text: $(item)Carving Knife$()$(br2)A blade meant for shaping wood into vessels the infusing ritual. Has no uses outside of stripping and whittling logs.
$(bold)Stripping$()$(br)Right-click any log or wood block to strip it, as an axe would.
$(bold)Carving the Chamber$()$(br)Right-click a $(item)Stripped Spruce Log$() to carve it into a $(item)Resonance Chamber$(). This transformation only works on spruce.
$(bold)Carving the Node$()$(br)Right-click a Resonance Chamber to carve it further into a $(item)Harmonic Node$(). This cannot be undone. $(br2)The knife has 128 uses before it breaks.
